parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Welcome to Holly's Supermarket. I'm sure you'll all enjoy working in our dedicated team here. So, what will you be doing? Well, we're open Monday through Sunday, so you'll need to be able to work weekends as well as irregular weekday shifts. These sometimes start at 5 a.m. or finish at 11 p.m. Your duties will include checking and unpacking lorry deliveries, as well as working on the shop floor, stocking shelves and so on. But you'll only be required to do manual lifting if the goods are light.

When the store is very busy, you'll also have to assess changing priorities. For example, if there's a queue at the tills, you'll jump on a spare one to help. If you notice something's been spilt and the surface is a little bit wet, you'll get a mop to clean it up, with no need to check with a manager first. Similarly, if bakery items are selling quickly, you'll help cook some more. And if a customer can't find, say, the apples, you'll instantly leave what you're doing and show them. But you'll still get time off to relax too, of course.

We pride ourselves on a positive attitude here. A little small talk shows you're interested in the customers and are providing excellent service, just as long as you don't overdo it and keep another customer waiting. And always smile. It forces you to stay positive, and being generally upbeat makes your whole team happy too. This increases efficiency and gives a good impression to customers. If it's quiet, help someone pack their bags. Customers really appreciate it, especially when they've bought more than they expected to.

Staying calm is also a necessity. If a customer's unhappy for any reason, keep cool and call for a supervisor to help defuse a situation if things are getting out of hand. Occasionally, when working tills, you'll find yourself waiting for someone to extract their wallet from the bottom of a cluttered bag while a long queue of annoyed customers builds up. You have to make sure, however hard it might be, that you remain composed.

So now let's look at the plan of the supermarket. Have you all got your plans? OK, good. We'll start with the staff entrance. Today you came in through the customer entrance, clearly marked on the bottom of your plan, but in future you'll enter through the door in the top left-hand corner of the diagram. Please don't confuse this with the emergency exits in the top right-hand corner and bottom left. It's very important that these are kept clear at all times.

Regarding the manager's office, some of you may have attended interviews here when it was next to the newspaper and magazine sales area. However, it's recently been moved and is now the circular space marked on the right of your plans. When the manager's not on the shop floor, that's where you'll find her.

The storage and unpacking area: you may be asked to help out here, both before and after opening hours. This is represented by the largest of the four rectangles in the top section of the plan. It tends to get very busy there at times, so please be careful on entering and leaving this area.

There's a kitchen on site where food and drinks are prepared for customers. It has specialist staff, but some of you may have to fill in occasionally. On the plan, it's shown by the triangular shape to the left of the tinned goods aisle. It's very busy, as many customers like to take a break in the cafe and read a newspaper before or after doing their shopping.

Cleaning equipment is stored in a cupboard. It's the smaller of the two squares marked near the vegetable and fruit section, and can come in very handy. You'd be surprised how often we have to mop up squashed tomatoes or grapes.

Finally, you'll be pleased to know there's a separate staff relaxation area. This is at the top of your plan, between the frozen goods section and the exit. As well as comfortable chairs, there's also a microwave for heating up snacks and a drinks dispenser. So, let's go there now.

analyses.content: 录音提到工作时间包括周末以及“不规律的轮班（irregular shifts）”，这要求员工必须在时间安排上很灵活。
Well, we're open Monday through Sunday, so you'll need to be able to work weekends as well as irregular weekday shifts. ... But you'll only be required to do manual lifting if the goods are light.
你可能听到 manual lifting（体力搬运）就想选 C，但录音明确说只有货物“很轻（light）”时才需要搬，排除了重物。

options.option: decide for themselves what needs doing.
options.optionContent: decide for themselves what needs doing.

analyses.content: When the store is very busy, you'll also have to assess changing priorities. ... If you notice something's been spilt ... you'll get a mop to clean it up, with no need to check with the manager first.
你可能想选 C（汇报事故），但录音强调的是直接拿拖把清理，而不是去汇报。
录音举例说遇到排队或地面湿滑等情况，你不需要先问经理（no need to check with the manager），即让你自己判断并处理。

options.option: helps everyone in the supermarket to relax.
options.optionContent: helps everyone in the supermarket to relax.

questions.question: The supervisor explains that when employees have a positive attitude, it

analyses.content: And always smile. It forces you to stay positive, and being generally upbeat makes your whole team happy too. This increases efficiency and gives a good impression to customers.
你可能听到 relax（放松）就选 A，但录音是说后面会给你时间放松，而不是积极态度能让大家放松。
录音明确指出，保持积极乐观能“提高效率（increases efficiency）”，这就对应了选项中的改善工作效能。

options.option: reports an employee to the manager.
options.optionContent: reports an employee to the manager.

questions.question: The supervisor says it is essential to stay calm when a customer

analyses.content: Occasionally, when working tills, you'll find yourself waiting for someone to extract their wallet from the bottom of a cluttered bag while a long queue of annoyed customers builds up.
你可能听到 annoyed customers（恼火的顾客）就选 C，但他们只是在排队等，并没有说拒绝等待或者插队。
录音描述了一个顾客在包底翻找钱包，导致后面排起了长队（queue... builds up），这明显是“耽误了其他购物者”。
Today you came in through the customer entrance, clearly marked on the bottom of your plan, but in future you'll enter through the door in the top left-hand corner of the diagram.
千万别看地图底部的 customer entrance，录音特意强调今天你是从那里进来的，但以后要走上面那个。
录音指示员工入口位于图表“左上角（top left-hand corner）”的那个门。
录音说经理办公室最近搬家了，现在是计划图右侧那个“圆形的（circular）”空间。
However, it's recently been moved and is now the circular space marked on the right of your plans.
听到 newspaper 别急着选，那是“以前（when it was...）”的位置，现在已经不在那儿了。
The storage and unpacking area... This is represented by the largest of the four rectangles in the top section of the plan.
这题纯考形状识别，听到 largest rectangles 就要去找最大的那个，别被 busy 这种词分心。
录音描述该区域是顶部四个长方形中“最大的（largest）”那一个。
On the plan, it's shown by the triangular shape to the left of the tinned goods aisle.
听到 cafe 不要乱找，录音是说顾客喜欢去 cafe 休息，而这里讲的是准备食物的 kitchen。
录音指出厨房是位于罐头食品（tinned goods）通道左侧的那个“三角形（triangular shape）”。
Cleaning equipment is stored in a cupboard. It's the smaller of the two squares marked near the vegetable and fruit section...
一定要听清 comparison（比较级），是 smaller 不是 bigger，别选错成旁边那个大的。
录音说清洁设备放在蔬菜水果区附近两个正方形中“较小的（smaller）”那个里。
Finally, you'll be pleased to know there's a separate staff relaxation area. This is at the top of your plan, between the frozen goods section and the exit.
听到 exit 别直接选出口，要找它旁边的位置；听到 microwave 只是在该区域里的东西，用来确认答案的。
录音定位该区域在地图顶部，夹在冷冻食品区和出口“之间（between）”。
